overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: its amended February 26, 2014 minutes gave a sufficiently detailed summary, complying with the prior OML 2014-119 order. The complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to comply with the prior OML 2014-119 order to amend its February 26, 2014 minutes with a sufficiently detailed summary of minutes and liaison-report discussions.
allegations.key_passage: Having reviewed the video of the Board's February 26, 2014 meeting as well as the minutes of that meeting as amended on October 22, 2014, we find that the Board has complied with our order by providing a sufficiently detailed summary of the Board's discussion.
